description: Defines the NamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory class, which implements factory creation logic for transactional state storage instances within Orleans transactions. It includes constructors, a Create method that retrieves or wraps storage providers, and handles dependency injection.

classes.name: NamedTransactionalStateStorageFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating transactional state storage instances, using dependency injection and supporting keyed storage retrievals.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ITransactionalStateStorage<TState> instance based on storage and state names, retrieving or wrapping storage providers as needed.
